description: Source code for an Android Wear OS watch face service implementing an analog watch face with second hand, ambient mode support, and dynamic styling based on background image.

classes.name: AnalogWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class extending CanvasWatchFaceService, creating the watch face engine.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine, handling drawing, updates, and lifecycle events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the watch face style, paints, loads background image, and sets up color palette.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the background, tick marks, and clock hands based on current time and mode.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the Engine.

methods.name: updateWatchHandStyle
methods.description: Updates paint styles for watch hands based on ambient mode.

methods.name: updateTimer
methods.description: Starts or stops the update handler based on visibility and mode.

methods.name: shouldTimerBeRunning
methods.description: Determines if the timer should be active (visible and not in ambient).
